_about: OpenAI (ChatGPT) ads have no API feed yet. Until there is a real number, each day counts at dailyBudget from startDate and the dashboard marks it 'est.'. To replace an estimate with the real figure, add the month under actuals (e.g. "2026-10": 412.37) — actuals always win.
